rules.message: a tier 1 application design states its key decisions, risks and scope (design standard §2)
a production platform design states its key decisions and scope (design standard §3)
a production platform hosts at least one approved application — upstream A4 → A3 (design standard §4.1)
a tier 1 application realises a BIAN service domain the bank adopts — upstream A3 → A2 (design standard §4.2)
an adopted service domain supports a business capability in the design's scope — upstream A2 → A1 (design standard §4.3)
